about_the_game:
🐾 Welcome to LITTLE CAT TINNY STRAYS! This adventure tells the story of a small stray kitten wandering through an abandoned industrial factory. A vast territory filled with hidden corners and hard-to-reach places becomes both a new home and a challenge. Your goal is to explore the area, collect food and collectible figurines, unlock new fur colors, and overcome every obstacle along the way.

✨ Exploration and freedom of movement The gameplay is built around dynamic movement across the factory. The kitten can run and jump, climb on crates, pipes, and metal frames, and explore rooftops, containers, and fences. The adventure also takes you indoors: into hangars, narrow corridors, empty offices, and technical rooms. Each level forms part of one large connected map, where vertical platforming and open navigation make every step feel like a discovery.

🎮 Core mechanics The main objective is to gather food and rare figurines scattered throughout the environment. You can also use the kitten’s meow, a charming feature that adds a playful touch to the experience. As you progress, you will face twenty increasingly challenging levels, each designed to test your agility and curiosity.

⭐ Rewards and style Completing objectives unlocks visual upgrades. New fur colors allow you to personalize your kitten and make the journey truly your own. These rewards add motivation to keep collecting and exploring every corner of the factory.

🏭 Final note LITTLE CAT TINNY STRAYS is an atmospheric 3D platformer that invites you to see the world through the eyes of a stray kitten. With twenty levels full of challenges, secrets, and discoveries, the question remains: can you collect everything and complete the journey?
